newsitem.title: CHINA: China province sentences 1,000 in three months.
newsitem.headline: China province sentences 1,000 in three months.

text.p: China's northwestern province of Gansu has sentenced 170 people to death, death with reprieve or life in prison for a range of crimes over a three-month period, the British Broadcasting Corp (BBC) said on Tuesday.
Courts in Gansu meted out the sentences between end-June and end-September as part of a nationwide crackdown on soaring crime, the BBC said, quoting provincial radio.
A total of 1,059 people were sentenced to five years in prison or longer imprisonment, it said but gave no details.
In the booming southern city of Shenzhen, 16 people were executed on October 30 for a range of violent crimes, the Shenzhen Legal Daily said in an edition seen in Beijing on Tuesday.
Crime, virtually wiped out in China in the years after the communists came to power in 1949, has surged in the past decade along with economic reforms.
China has executed more than 1,000 people since launching a nationwide "Strike Hard" campaign against crime in late April.
